title: spec: ActionSchema declares `disabled` but no authored reason, so a header action cannot say why it is unavailable (e.g. "You are the only owner; transfer ownership first")
body:
Filing gate: **(b) a named producer is blocked by it.** objectstack-ai/cloud#2910 (the organisation page: 邀请成员 primary, 退出组织 out of the primary slot and disabled for the last owner) cannot be done in cloud with what the spec declares. The os-dev on that card measured each gap with contract probes at framework `f7e836da` / objectui `ef71a09f` (report on cloud#2910). Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6026, session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`). ⛔ Not a claim.
Dedupe: no open objectstack issue names `disabledReason` or an action's disabled reason.

## The gap
- `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` L1495–1505 declares the `disabled` predicate. An authored reason is refused: `disabledReason` → `unrecognized_keys`.
- objectui's `page:header` (`containers.tsx` L2155–2159 at `ef71a09f`) can only draw the generic 「Not available for this record」. Its own comment says an author-written reason "would be a spec key, which is objectstack's to declare".

## Done when
- `ActionSchema` declares a reason key (`I18nLabel`) beside `disabled`, enforced as declare-means-enforce.
- The console reads it for both the inline tooltip and the ⋯ second line. That part is objectui's follow-up once the key ships.

The first consumer is `leave_organization` for the last owner (cloud#2910).
